stories.title: strands-labs/strands-decider
stories.reason: Strands Decider: a ~1.9B-param Qwen3.5 decoder with its LM head removed and a ~1M-param pointer head added, so one forward pass scores options instead of decoding. Reports calibrated confidence (95% accuracy at 0.9+ confidence on unseen short-classification tasks) and 115ms/question on an RTX 3090. Running code, 564 stars, genuinely novel serving-focused architecture.
key_facts: Built on Qwen3.5-2B-Base with LM head removed, ~1M-param pointer head added
Claims 95%+ accuracy when confidence >=0.9 on unseen short-classification tasks
Median 115ms/question on RTX 3090; state read once, reused across questions
Benchmarked on JevBench (231 tasks); also ships Gemma 4 variants (E2B-26B-A4B) and a vision mode

stories.title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
stories.reason: Talorys: single-user personal AI agent that deploys entirely within Cloudflare's free tier (Pages, Workers, one Durable Object w/ SQLite, Workers AI) with no always-on process, cost guardrails, and local PBKDF2-SHA256 auth. Strong, verifiable serving/deployment story with running code; already fairly visible (259 HN pts).
key_facts: Single Durable Object (Cloudflare Agents SDK) holds SQLite state; alarms replace an always-on process
Chat model is @cf/zai-org/glm-4.7-flash via Workers AI, streamed as SSE
Stays within free tier by avoiding R2/D1/KV; caps output tokens, context size, tool calls, daily AI requests
One-command installer: npx create-talorys@latest; MIT licensed, no telemetry
